name: manual_80f818
claim: For already published disjoint PRs, preserve contributor commits with ordinary additive stack merges and explicit predecessor bases; prove contributor files are byte-unchanged and run combined tests before publication, while keeping cross-repository memory PRs separate and cross-linked.

decisions.notes: Codex reviewer stacked Orama PR467 then PR468 then PR469 without conflicts or force-push, retaining all three contributions byte-for-byte. Combined suite passed 85 tests with four Windows-only skips. PT PR477 remains a main-based memory companion rather than a cross-repository Git stack.
